human_instruction: ReviewCompass3に属する未記録分をすべて記録して

scope_change.prior_scope: one previously authorized current Codex Desktop rollout only
scope_change.new_scope: all locally available Codex rollout logs whose session working directory is the ReviewCompass3 repository root or one of its descendants

authorized_capture.selection_rule: session_meta.payload.cwd resolves to the ReviewCompass3 repository root or one of its descendants

required_boundaries: do not capture Codex logs belonging to another working directory
do not modify provider source logs
do not place private transcript artifacts in Git
do not enable a hook, watcher, scheduler, service, or background process
do not delete or overwrite a diverged preserved prefix
report the unavoidable live-session tail after the final synchronous capture
